"""Bounded hosted audit of #771. Usage: python -B audit-771.py NEW OLD OUTPUT."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import runpy
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

root, old, output = map(lambda p: Path(p).resolve(), sys.argv[1:])
preflight = runpy.run_path(str(Path(__file__).parent / "pystachy-audit-762-publish/docs/reports/compatibility-2026-10-20-release-replay.py"))["source_snapshot"]
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("PYSTACHY_") and k not in ("PYTHONPATH", "PYTHONHOME")}
env.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1", LC_ALL="C", PYSTACHY_JOBS="2")
data = {"new_source": preflight(root), "old_source": preflight(old), "python": sys.version,
        "compiler": "CPython-hosted; no native compiler or LLVM available", "records": []}
assert data["new_source"]["clean_before_generation"] and data["old_source"]["clean_before_generation"]

def run(command, cwd=root, extra=None, ir=False):
    start = time.monotonic()
    p = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env | (extra or {}), capture_output=True, timeout=300)
    row = {"command": command, "cwd": str(cwd), "environment_overrides": extra or {}, "exit": p.returncode,
           "seconds_advisory": time.monotonic()-start, "stderr": p.stderr.decode(errors="replace")}
    row.update({"stdout_sha256": hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest(), "stdout_bytes": len(p.stdout)} if ir
               else {"stdout": p.stdout.decode(errors="replace")})
    data["records"].append(row)
    return p

def tree(path):
    raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "HEAD"], cwd=path, text=True)
    return {line.split("\t")[1]: line.split()[2] for line in raw.splitlines()}

def cases(tree, new):
    result = {}
    patterns = (("programs", r"tests/programs/[^/]+/[^/]+\.py$" if new else r"tests/[^/]+\.py$"),
                ("errors", r"tests/errors/[^/]+/[^/]+\.py$" if new else r"tests/errors/[^/]+\.py$"),
                ("deviations", r"tests/deviations/[^/]+\.py$"))
    for suite, pattern in patterns:
        for path, blob in tree.items():
            if re.fullmatch(pattern, path):
                key = suite + "/" + Path(path).name
                assert key not in result, key
                result[key] = {"path": path, "blob": blob}
    return result

oldtree, newtree = tree(old), tree(root)
before, after = cases(oldtree, False), cases(newtree, True)
assert set(before) == set(after)
changed = []
for key in sorted(before):
    a, b = before[key], after[key]
    if a["blob"] != b["blob"]:
        row = {"case": key, "old": a, "new": b}
        if key.startswith("programs/"):
            row["ast_equal"] = ast.dump(ast.parse((old/a["path"]).read_text())) == ast.dump(ast.parse((root/b["path"]).read_text()))
        changed.append(row)
data["case_inventory"] = {"counts": {s: sum(k.startswith(s+"/") for k in after) for s in ("programs", "errors", "deviations")},
    "same_suite_and_name_set": True, "total": len(after), "changed_contents": changed,
    "old_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(before, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
    "new_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(after, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()}
data["missing_sidecars"] = []
data["changed_sidecars"] = []
for key, a in before.items():
    for suffix in (".out", ".err", ".in", ".path", ".full"):
        ap = str(Path(a["path"]).with_suffix(suffix))
        bp = str(Path(after[key]["path"]).with_suffix(suffix))
        if ap in oldtree and bp not in newtree:
            data["missing_sidecars"].append([ap, bp])
        if oldtree.get(ap) != newtree.get(bp):
            data["changed_sidecars"].append({"old_path": ap, "new_path": bp, "old_blob": oldtree.get(ap), "new_blob": newtree.get(bp)})
assert not data["missing_sidecars"]
data["implementation_changes"] = [p for p in sorted(set(oldtree)|set(newtree))
    if oldtree.get(p) != newtree.get(p) and (p.startswith(("src/", "lib/", "ports/")) and p.endswith(".py")
                                          or p in ("pystachy.py", "runtime.py", "runtime.c", "pyembed.c", "pyext.c"))]
data["specs_ast_equal"] = ast.dump(ast.parse((old/"src/pystachy_compiler/specs.py").read_text())) == ast.dump(ast.parse((root/"src/pystachy_compiler/specs.py").read_text()))
assert data["implementation_changes"] == ["src/pystachy_compiler/specs.py"] and data["specs_ast_equal"]
for pattern in ("test_*verif*.py", "test_typed*.py", "test_port_check.py", "test_re_specialize.py", "test_coverage_report.py", "test_workflow_limits.py"):
    run([sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tools", "-p", pattern, "-v"])
    print(pattern, data["records"][-1]["exit"], flush=True)
for path in ("tests/corpus.sh", "tests/run.sh", "tests/record.sh", "tests/verify.sh", "tools/shard_cases.sh", "tools/coverage.sh", "tools/runtime_coverage.sh", "tools/irsame.sh", "tools/check_ir.sh"):
    run(["sh", "-n", path])
run(["sh", "tests/verify.sh", "--list"])
corpus = run(["sh", "-c", ". tests/corpus.sh; corpus"]).stdout.decode().splitlines()
assert set(corpus) == {v["path"] for v in after.values()} and len(corpus) == len(after)
assert not run(["sh", "-c", ". tests/corpus.sh; corpus_strays"]).stdout
data["shards"] = {}
for n in (2, 3):
    shards = [run(["sh", "tools/shard_cases.sh", f"{i}/{n}"], ir=True).stdout.decode().splitlines() for i in range(n)]
    assert len(set(sum(shards, []))) == len(corpus) == len(sum(shards, []))
    data["shards"][str(n)] = [len(x) for x in shards]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="audit-771-counts-") as temp:
    for checkout in (old, root):
        code = (checkout/"tests/verify.sh").read_text()
        checks = re.search(r"^checks\(\) \{.*?^\}", code, re.M | re.S)[0]
        script = (". tests/corpus.sh\n" if checkout == root else "") + checks + f'\nV={temp}\nchecks "jit aot"\nchecks "jit"\n'
        run(["sh", "-c", script], cwd=checkout)
        assert data["records"][-1]["stdout"] == "5093\n3545\n"
for name in ("lib_difflib", "lib_difflib_grouped", "lib_difflib_unified", "os_path_stat", "realpath", "module_doc"):
    rel = after["programs/"+name+".py"]["path"]
    path = root/rel
    mp = path.with_suffix(".path")
    extra = {"PYTHONPATH": mp.read_text().strip()} if mp.exists() else {}
    p = run([sys.executable, "-B", rel, "a1", "a2"], extra=extra)
    expected = path.with_suffix(".out").read_bytes()
    actual = p.stdout + f"[exit {p.returncode}]\n".encode()
    err = path.with_suffix(".err")
    errmatch = p.stderr.splitlines()[-1:] == err.read_bytes().splitlines() if err.exists() else not p.stderr
    data["records"][-1]["recording_matches"] = actual == expected and bool(errmatch)
    assert data["records"][-1]["recording_matches"], name
    run([sys.executable, "-B", "pystachy.py", "ir", rel], extra={"PYSTACHY_PATH": extra.get("PYTHONPATH", "")}, ir=True)
# Rejection-sidecar handling is a changed harness path. These selected cases never invoke LLVM.
rejections = [str(p.relative_to(root).with_suffix(".py")) for p in sorted((root/"tests/errors").glob("*/*.path"))]
data["rejection_sidecar_count"] = len(rejections)
run(["sh", "tests/run.sh", sys.executable+" -B -m pystachy", "jit aot", *rejections])
data["source_after"] = preflight(root)
data["replay_source"] = Path(__file__).read_text()
output.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"counts": data["case_inventory"]["counts"], "records": len(data["records"]),
                  "failed_commands": [r["command"] for r in data["records"] if r["exit"] and not r.get("recording_matches")]}))
